description: This file contains functions and interfaces for automating pull request approval in a GitHub Actions context, including extracting action inputs, deciding whether to approve a PR, and submitting an approval review.

methods.name: getActionInputs
methods.description: Extracts and constructs action input parameters from command line inputs and GitHub webhook payload.

methods.name: shouldApprove
methods.description: Determines whether a pull request should be approved based on source and target repositories, requested reviewers, and allowed reviewers.

methods.name: approvePr
methods.description: Submits an approval review for a pull request using the GitHub API.
